primary_size_coordinate.reason: Counts labelled graph vertices while retaining the exact source-compatible square power-of-two domain.

recurrence_contract.increment: L_{n+1} >= L_n + delta_n with delta_n >= d(n) >= 0

superlogarithmic_composition_gate.polarity: Because N_n<=h(n), log N_n<=log h(n); this sufficient condition implies L_n/log N_n->infinity.
failure_worlds: the proved cumulative lower bound is o(log h(n))
the proved cumulative lower bound is Theta(log h(n))
superlogarithmic_composition_gate.failure_interpretation: These worlds refute or fail the chosen recurrence proof; without an upper bound they do not prove the actual L_n or rho rate.

non_guarantees: Unbounded certificate mass in n alone is not a meaningful input-size rate.
A bounded or logarithmic chosen certificate does not upper-bound rho_frac or rho.
A superlogarithmic full-cover checkpoint is only superlinear in Boolean input length.
A superpolynomial circuit lower bound for the source E-language wrapper does not establish P != NP without NP membership or a reduction.
Finite evaluations cannot decide an asymptotic outcome.

family_domain.registered_form: U_n subset [M_n]x[M_n] is the complement ground set, M_n=2^n; G_n := [M_n]x[M_n] minus U_n is the associated graph transferred to Boolean complexity.
family_domain.reason: C024/C037 full-semi-filter relevance is defined from complement U_n, while Proposition 38/Lemma 39 transfer the associated graph G_n.
family_domain.padding_policy: No rectangular-to-square or non-power-of-two padding is assumed. Any later padding requires a separate relevance- and load-preserving theorem.

explicit_graph_description.definition: D_n = M_n^2 + (2 floor(log2 M_n)+1) + (2 floor(log2 M_n)+1) bits
explicit_graph_description.encoding: Elias-gamma code for each positive side size, followed by the row-major M_n by M_n adjacency table of G_n (equivalently the bitwise-negated U_n table).
proved_bounds: log D_n = Theta(log N_n) as n -> infinity
explicit_graph_description.role: Description length of the graph instance, not Boolean-function input length.

boolean_function_input_scale.direct_adjacency_definition: a_n = 2n bits for f_{G_n}(r,c), where G_n=[M_n]^2\U_n
boolean_function_input_scale.source_wrapper_definition: b_n = 2n + 1 bits for the related total Boolean function in the source remark
roles: a_n is the direct adjacency-predicate input length
b_n is the source wrapper input length
boolean_function_input_scale.warning: Graph-description length D_n, direct input a_n, and wrapper input b_n are distinct coordinates.

uniform_explicitness.local_graph_family_requirement: Given n and n-bit labels r,c, decide U_n membership uniformly in time polynomial in M_n=2^n; decide G_n membership by negation with the same bound.
uniform_explicitness.local_language_consequence: The direct graph adjacency predicate f_{G_n} is thereby in E; this does not place it in NP and does not by itself advance P versus NP.
uniform_explicitness.forbidden_combination: Do not simultaneously require deterministic polynomial time in n for the direct predicate and claim an a_n^{omega(1)} circuit lower bound; P is contained in P/poly.
root_bridge_options: prove the direct adjacency language is in NP via a polynomial-time verifier without giving a deterministic polynomial-time decider
or exhibit a separate NP language with a lower-bound-preserving reduction to/from the graph predicate in the required direction
uniform_explicitness.forbidden_shortcut: A target-exposed LP-selected lookup sequence with no uniform 2^{O(n)} membership algorithm is not an explicit family.

frozen_certificate_route_outcomes.condition: there exist 0<c<=C<infinity and n0 such that c log N_n <= L_n <= C log N_n for all n>=n0
sup_n L_n = infinity, while L_n/log N_n neither tends to 0 nor tends to infinity and no eventual two-sided Theta(log N_n) bounds hold

epistemic_outcome.condition: The evidence does not determine a mathematical certificate-route branch.

inference_boundary: The non-superlogarithmic branches classify only the selected feasible certificate mass L_n. They do not upper-bound rho_frac(U_n) or rho(U_n). Failure of the recurrence lower bound is RECURRENCE_BOUND_INSUFFICIENT unless an independent matching upper bound or exact formula proves an actual rate limitation.

root_rate_gate.checkpoint: A lower bound on rho(G_n,G_{M_n,M_n})=rho_induced_by_complement(U_n) transfers at most to a superlinear circuit checkpoint for f_{G_n} or the source wrapper.
root_rate_gate.root_required_strength: A P-versus-NP route via circuits requires an NP language with circuit complexity a_n^{omega(1)} (or the corresponding wrapper/reduction scale), plus a proved language-membership or reduction bridge.
root_rate_gate.local_E_language_boundary: A b_n^{omega(1)} lower bound for the uniformly 2^{O(n)}-decidable source wrapper would concern an E language, not automatically an NP language.
root_rate_gate.sufficient_family_of_limits: For every fixed q>0, (L_0+sum_{i<n}d(i))/(log h(n))^q -> infinity is a sufficient graph-scale lower-bound rate, but it has root force only after an NP-language bridge.
